items.title: Initech Systems consolidates divisions ahead of platform expansion
items.snippet: Initech Systems is consolidating two divisions under a single operations lead as it prepares a company-wide platform expansion.

items.title: Initech Systems is hiring: Onboarding Program Lead
items.snippet: Initech Systems posted an opening for an Onboarding Program Lead to cut new-division ramp time, a pain point named by division leads.
